steps: Identify the velocity equation for SHM starting from equilibrium: v(t) = Aω cos(ωt).
Calculate the angular frequency: ω = 2π / T = 2π / 16 = π/8 rad/s.
Substitute the given values at t = 2 s into the velocity equation: v(2) = A(π/8) cos(π/4) = π.
Use the given value for cos(45°) = 1/√2.
Solve for the amplitude A: A(π/8)(1/√2) = π.
This gives A = 8√2 m, which matches option (D).
